title: Responsible gaming
summary: PrediGol informs; it is not a bookmaker and promotes no operator. Betting means losing money, and no probability prevents it.

sections.title: 1. What PrediGol does and what it does not

blocks.p: PrediGol shows football information and analysis. It takes no bets, pays no winnings, has no links to place bets and recommends no operator.
Only people aged 18 or over may use it.
Every bet can be lost. A high probability fails often: 70% fails three times out of ten. Good runs do not announce the next ones.

ul: You bet more money or more often than you had decided.
You try to win back what you lost with new bets.
You bet money you need for other things, or borrow to bet.
You hide how much you bet, or betting causes you anxiety or arguments.
Set beforehand how much you can lose, and do not go over it.
Take breaks, and do not bet under pressure, after drinking or when tired.
Use only operators authorised in Colombia by Coljuegos.
Línea 192, option 4, of Colombia's Ministry of Health and Social Protection: free mental-health guidance.
«Toma el control», Coljuegos' responsible-gaming site (tomaelcontrol.coljuegos.gov.co), and its e-mail colombiajuegaresponsable@coljuegos.gov.co.

blocks.p: If you feel gambling is harming you, talk to someone you trust or to a health professional.

statements.risk_notice: I understand that PrediGol's forecasts are probabilities, not guarantees, and I have read the responsible gaming page.
